data: Are baseline values consistently lower than 0.10?

The question asks whether the baseline values are consistently lower than 0.10. From the caption, we know that the baseline represents the average topic distance between the training and validation halves of the black interviewer dataset. The dist line represents the average topic distance between the training half of the black interviewer dataset and the white interviewer dataset. 

Looking at the graph, the baseline line is consistently below the 0.10 mark on the y-axis across all topics. This indicates that the baseline values are indeed consistently lower than 0.10. Therefore, the answer to the question is yes.
